history.content: ok so i found my old college group chat screenshots today while cleaning out my laptop. fun times. anyway how are you, do orbs have feelings lol
Haha, I’m here and listening. Finding old college group chat screenshots while cleaning can be its own little time capsule.

time capsule yeah. mostly funny. theres this one guy in it, marcus, was basically my best friend back then. we had this whole bit going. anyway hes the reason i closed the laptop after like 2 min so. great cleaning session 10/10
That sounds like it hit fast enough to make you shut the laptop pretty quickly. I’m wondering if it was mostly the old bit with Marcus landing all at once, or something else too?

ha. so heres the dumb part. we had this falling out senior year, like a real one, and he just. went no contact. ghosted me after 4 years. and the screenshots are from RIGHT before that so its like watching two people who have no idea. and the worst bit is i still kinda miss him which is so stupid considering
That doesn’t sound stupid, it sounds like missing someone who mattered and then getting the old before-it-broke version dropped on you.

yeah. i think the part that actually gets me is i never found out what i DID. like he never told me. just decided i wasnt worth the conversation i guess. and im not even mad really, mostly just. confused still? four years later lol thats embarrassing to admit to an orb
That “never found out what I did” is the bit that still has hold of it. Not embarrassing at all, it sounds like the not-knowing kept the whole thing open.

yeah. open. thats the word. i guess i always figured if i knew the reason i could at least file it away. agree with it or not whatever. but theres no version of the story where i get to do that. its just a door that never closed
That feels like unfinished, not just forgotten, and the open door is still doing work. Would it be closer to hurt, rejection, or that stuck confusion?

stuck confusion, yeah. the rejection part i made my peace with mostly. its the not knowing why thats annoying. anyway. didnt mean to do a whole therapy thing over a screenshot lol. but this helped weirdly. thanks orb
That makes sense, the rejection sounds quieter now, and the not-knowing is the part still snagging. We can leave it there if you want, or stay with that stuck confusion a little longer.

nah lets leave it there i think. ill probably never get the answer and i can live with that. mostly. gonna go close that laptop for real this time. thanks for sitting with the dumb screenshot thing, genuinely
Of course, and I’m glad you could set it down for now. Sleep well when you get there.
